answer.rationale: Renewal currently best protects uninterrupted delivery with the line at 94% committed volume, no buffer, and only 14 days before expiry. The low-cost vendor could support the mandated savings, so memory_c2 should be verified for evidence about onboarding and delivery performance before rejecting that alternative; its summary does not establish reliability at current volume. Renewal will not by itself achieve the 18% target, but an immediate primary-vendor switch could increase total cost of ownership through disruption or missed deliveries.
